invariants.claim: Independent source syntax, production ASTs and bounded formatting preserve ordered Table SQL and logical test products
scenarios: Complete source/template syntax and typed-hole sites
Malformed unused bodies and stage refusals
UTF-8 byte coordinates and source formatting
Independent AST, precedence and coverage negative controls

invariants.qualification: Required transitc checks; inherited historical evidence does not qualify this compiler revision.

invariants.claim: Nominal source operands and exhaustive compile-time selection preserve the selected ordered typed Table actions before scalar SQL erasure
scenarios: Distinct Machine/Site nominal identities with equal raw ID 7
All reached MATCH arms checked with symbolic payload types; wrong domains and Table signatures refuse
Exact typed operands, independent emitted SQL, real counts and complete rows
Three audited Lean laws and sixteen finite source/action comparisons; swapped domain/value/binding and incomplete-proof controls
invariants.limits: Lean models exact source types, de Bruijn binding, one scalar payload per constructor, total checked arm tables and ordered inserts. It assumes well-typed environments and Table bindings; it does not prove the parser, source checker, complete Zig evaluator, SQL/runtime, authority, progress or effects. Finite implementation comparisons are separate from the laws.
invariants.qualification: Required transitc checks; inherited historical evidence does not qualify this compiler revision.
